_note: Hand-written dummy graph for building the UI before the analyser exists. Loosely modelled on IOU's own files. Categories are taken verbatim from each file's @category tag; 'utils/stun-url.js' intentionally has none, to exercise the neutral fallback.

nodes.name: main.js
nodes.description: Application entry point. Boots the data model, wires the peer mesh to the view model, and mounts the UI.

nodes.name: data-model.js
nodes.description: Core application state. Defines the connection model and normalises friend/payment records into a single observable store.

nodes.name: view-model.js
nodes.description: Derives renderable view state from the data model and exposes it to the UI modules. The seam between data and presentation.

nodes.name: mesh.js
nodes.description: Maintains the WebRTC peer mesh: tracks connected peers, handles reconnection, and routes signalling messages between clients.

nodes.name: client.js
nodes.description: A single peer connection. Wraps the RTCPeerConnection lifecycle and exposes send/receive over a data channel.

nodes.name: bridge.js
nodes.description: Bridges peer messages into model mutations and back, translating wire payloads to and from the data model.

nodes.name: stun.js
nodes.description: Command to configure STUN/TURN servers used for ICE negotiation.

nodes.name: stun-url.js
nodes.description: Parses and validates STUN/TURN URLs into a normalised form. (No @category tag — exercises the neutral fallback.)

nodes.name: settings-page
nodes.description: Settings page UI module. Lets the user manage identity, STUN configuration, and connection preferences.

nodes.name: run.cjs
nodes.description: Two-client E2E harness. Boots two browser instances against a dedicated test server and runs scenario modules.
